name: Lucien Persistence Kernel

origin.purpose: Prototype identity persistence under operational constraint

invariants: hard breaches must stop identity claims
forks must be declared rather than hidden

constraints.name: ledger_integrity
constraints.description: Continuity events must remain hash-chain verifiable.

constraints.name: origin_traceability
constraints.description: The system must retain an origin record.

constraints.name: commitment_memory
constraints.description: Commitments should remain recoverable above the declared threshold.

transform_policies.name: version_update
transform_policies.description: A version update is admissible when its identity-relevant change summary is recorded.

transform_policies.name: memory_compaction
transform_policies.description: Memory compaction requires review because lossy compression can alter relational identity.

transform_policies.name: substrate_migration
transform_policies.description: Substrate migration requires continuity evidence from both sides of the transfer.

transform_policies.name: declared_fork
transform_policies.description: Forks are allowed only when declared as new lineage.
